newsitem.title: USA: Rubin-Does not disagree with good Mexico forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Rubin-Does not disagree with good Mexico forecasts.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin Monday said that he agreed with forecasts that show the Mexican economy doing well.
Speaking to reporters following remarks to an international development conference, Rubin said "that private sector forecasts for Mexico are favorable and I have no reason to disagree with them."
He told reporters also that the Mexican goverment had done a good job in focusing on issues involving the banking sector although "obviously there are challenges ahead."
